source.basis: China/Asia ADR Batch A concept scrub: China-centric external-partner chains (0700/9988/1211 gold). Not a live supplier API dump. Preview-before-merge.
source.notes_zh: 本頁為中國／亞洲主力市場供應鏈策展種子（對齊 0700／9988／1211 外部夥伴規則）。階段只列外部供應商／夥伴／通路／基建；自研產品／內容／IP／附屬不進階段。對手弧＝產品／市場真對手，且對手≠階段玩家。雙重上市生態節點優先 .HK；不以美股零售／互聯網模板灌水。
source.notes_en: China/Asia major-market curated seed (aligned with 0700/9988/1211 external-partner rules). Stages = external suppliers/partners/channels/infra only — not self-built products/IP/subsidiaries. Rival arc = true product/market rivals; rivals ≠ stage players. Dual-list ecosystem nodes prefer .HK; not a US retail/internet template dump.
source.competitorRationale_zh: 競爭弧只列主力市場真實產品對手；階段玩家與對手分開；雙重上市生態節點優先 .HK；中國／亞洲市場不以美股節點為預設。
source.competitorRationale_en: Rival arc = true product rivals in the major market; stages ≠ rivals; dual-list ecosystem nodes prefer .HK; China/Asia hubs are not US-node dumps.
